title: Pan2025: Cross-session motor imagery dataset from Pan et al. 2025
description: A cross-session motor imagery EEG dataset from 10 healthy participants who performed cued left- versus right-hand motor imagery across two sessions. Recordings used 28 EEG channels sampled at 250 Hz with a Neuroscan SynAmps2 amplifier, with roughly 180 trials per session. In session 2, test trials included online feedback. The data were re-released in BIDS format via MOABB for brain-computer interface research.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan SynAmps2 amplifier from 28 channels in a 10-10 montage at 250 Hz, with a 0.01-200 Hz online bandpass filter and a 50 Hz notch filter. Each trial was a cued left- or right-hand motor imagery task (4 s rest, 4 s task). In session 2, the first 30 trials were used for training and the remaining trials were test trials with online feedback.
